channel.title: Queen's University Athletics - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Queen's University Athletics (gogaelsgo.com)

item.title: Queen's Men's Volleyball defeat RMC in straight sets again for weekend sweep
item.description: Queen's Men's Volleyball defeated the RMC Paladins 3-0 (25-31, 25-14, 25-9) Saturday for their second straight sets win in a row over their crosstown rivals this season.

item.title: Gaels Remain Unbeaten After Narrow 66-64 Win Over Badgers
item.description: The Queen's Gaels women's basketball team kept their perfect season intact on Saturday, January 24, edging out the Brock Badgers 66-64 to extend their undefeated record to 17-0. In a game that went down to the final moments, the Gaels showed composure and resilience to secure another hard-earned victory.

item.title: Queen's earn five medals at McGill Team Challange, including double golf for Caleigh Pribaz and gold for Jude Wheeler-Dee
item.description: Queen's Cross Country and Distance Track competed at the McGill Team Challenge this past weekend, earning five medals at the meet.

item.title: Queen's Squash picks up two medals in A draw, four medals in B draw at Jesters Canadian University and College Individual Squash Championships
item.description: The Queen's Men's and Women's Squash teams competed in the Jesters Canadian University and College Individual Squash Championships in Montreal at McGill University this past weekend. 124 athletes from 7 provinces competed over the three days.

item.title: 2026 season ticket packages for defending Yates Cup champion Queen’s Football on sale NOW
item.description: Queen's Football is defending the Yates Cup in 2026; make sure you're along for the ride!

item.title: Causeway Clash: Queen’s and RMC commemorate 140-years of rivalry, in 2026 Carr-Harris Cup
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey and their crosstown rivals, the RMC Paladins, will clash on the ice for the second time this regular season on Saturday, Feb. 7. This time, however, the matchup moves beyond the historic confines of Memorial Centre and the close-quarters intensity of Constantine Arena to the bright lights of Slush Puppie Place downtown, and with a trophy in the building and citywide bragging rights on the line.

item.title: Queen’s Women's Fencing win Individual Gold & Silver, Team Bronze, Overall Bronze, and O’Donnell Trophy at OUA Fencing Women’s Championships
item.description: The 2026 Women's Fencing OUA Championships were held at the Peterborough Memorial Centre hosted at Trent University. In the individual events held on Saturday, the Queen's Gaels Queen's had an exceptional first day, with a gold, a silver, and four additional top 16 finishes.

item.title: Queen's Women's Hockey's School Day Game strengthens community connections through sport
item.description: Friday's 3-1 win over the Carleton Ravens will help Queen's Women's Hockey in their quest for the OUA Playoffs, but the game meant far more than the two points the Gaels earned in the standings.

item.title: Six Queen's Football players invited to CFL Combines
item.description: Six Queen's Football players were invited to the upcoming CFL Combines, the Canadian Football League announced on Thursday.

item.title: Eight Queen's Women's Rugby players selected to Canadian National U21 squad for March tour
item.description: Eight Queen's Women's Rugby players were selected to the Canadian National u21 squad for a tour in March.
